name: Should I repair or replace my roof during an exterior renovation?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my roof during an exterior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace your roof depends on its age, condition, and the extent of damage. If your roof is relatively new (under 10-15 years) and has isolated damage, repairs might suffice. However, if it's nearing the end of its lifespan (typically 20-30 years for asphalt shingles), has widespread damage, or exhibits signs of significant wear like curling or missing shingles, a full replacement is usually more cost-effective in the long run. A professional inspection can help determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decide between roof repair or replacement based on its age, condition, and damage extent; repairs for minor issues on newer roofs, replacement for older roofs or widespread damage.
